features.title: Changed-files card and review tab
features.summary: The native "Edited N files" card under a turn, its per-file hover comparison, the right-sidebar review tab, delivery cards and closing-prose file mentions, from one owned fork of the stock row.
features.currentSurface: chat transcript: the card under a turn that edited files, and the review tab it opens

onboarding.firstAction: Ask the agent to edit a file, then open a row of the Edited files card under its reply.
onboarding.doneWhen: The file's changes show under the row or in the review tab.

failureModes: A summary the Host no longer serves (Session disposed, Host restarted) shows that the turn's changes are no longer available.
A failed comparison read shows a Retry button.

telemetry.reason: The routes are the native ones registered through Connection's authenticated fetch; the comparisons are computed by core workspaceChanges, which owns their spans.

verification.reason: Every vendored file equals the pinned tag (node scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs deliverables).

features.title: Changed images preview instead of the binary placeholder
features.summary: A changed png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, svg or avif file that the card or review tab would answer with "Binary file" or "File too large" shows the image itself, labelled Current version. The Host route api/changes.image serves the listed file's current bytes: only inside the Session's working directory after resolving symlinks, only an image extension, under its own media type with a sandboxing Content-Security-Policy and nosniff, and at most 8 MB. The turn-start ("before") bytes are not shown: workspaceChanges serves no bytes, its turn-start snapshot objects live in a Session-private temporary object directory, and neither jj nor git records the working copy at turn start, so the current file is the only correct side available.

features.currentSurface: chat transcript: a changed image row's hover preview in the Edited files card, and the review tab
failureModes: An image deleted or moved after the turn shows that it is no longer in the workspace and to restore it from version control.
An image larger than 8 MB answers 413 and the card says to open the file in the sidebar or an external app.
A listed image outside the working directory, directly or through a symlink or .., answers 403 and the card says to open it in an external app.
Any other failed read shows Retry.

telemetry.reason: One bounded local file read per request inside Connection's authenticated route; it fetches nothing, spawns nothing and runs no long job.
